description: Automatic signing: remove the stored signature of a recipient (signature.status becomes 'revoked' and the recipient.signature.revoked webhook fires) or cancel a pending enrolment so its link stops working. Envelopes already waiting on the automatic signature fall back to a signing link emailed to the recipient. Idempotent: a recipient without a stored signature is returned unchanged. Required before delete_recipient while a signature is active or an enrolment is pending.
name: remove_recipient_signature
